versions.changelog:
- Added scripts/_paths.py and scripts/sync.py to the skill
- scripts/sync.py provides a built-in version self-check tool for skills with scripts/
- sync.py usage is now documented in the SKILL.md (e.g., for checking if the installed skill is behind the latest version)
- Updated usage instructions and parameter defaults in SKILL.md; removed reference to previous default prefix behavior — by default, no prefix is added to skill identifiers
- Removed the old skill-card.md file

- Initial release of ym-skill-generator with core features for skill generation, auditing, sanitization, and packaging.
- Supports generating compliant skill skeletons (SKILL.md, references, scripts, templates) based on user needs and triggers.
- Includes automated risk auditing before packaging, checking for 9 types of issues with actionable, graded reports.
- Enables packaging of ready-to-use, distributable skill bundles; produced bundles conform to platform requirements.
- Provides skill icon generation and compliance checking as part of the workflow (icons generated separately from skill bundles).
- Commands and documentation are streamlined for quick adoption, with clear defaults and usage guidance.
